main_subject.detail: A dramatic stadium poster showing two football players from behind walking arm in arm onto the field. One wears a striped light-blue-and-white jersey with number 10, and the other wears a red jersey with number 19. The huge headline asks 'CUOC HOI NGO SAU 19 NAM NGOI VUONG SE GOI TEN AI?'. The scene is packed with confetti, bright stadium lights, and a giant translucent Techcombank diamond shape behind the players. Bottom-right text says 'TECHCOMBANK & HE SINH THAI DONG HANH CUNG VTV thuc hien su menh phung su Quoc gia mang FIFA WORLD CUP 2026 TM Den trieu trieu trai tim Viet Nam'. Bottom-left line says 'VUOT TROI MOI NGAY'.
